title: Tenga Seiha
overview:
The men of a turbulent age rage to rule the land! A bold Sengoku picture scroll woven by history!!

A story that unfolds faithfully to historical fact, and a battle system using a quarter view and real-time combat. Boldly told, the life of Tokugawa Ieyasu up to his conquest of the land!

天下を統べんと乱世の漢達が猛る！歴史が織りなす豪快戦国絵巻!!

史実に忠実に展開していくストーリー、クオータービュー・リアルタイム制を採用した戦闘システム。徳川家康が天下制覇を成し遂げるまでの人生を豪放に綴る！
